title: Axon Group Annual Leave Policy
sourceDocument: Axon Group Annual Leave Policy V3.docx
principles: Lex Loci Laboris — local statutory minimums apply based on physical work location.
Favor Laboris — any term less favourable than local statute is void; local law prevails.
South Africa enforces a 25-day contractual accumulation cap; other jurisdictions use excessive-leave directives instead of hard forfeiture where prohibited.

ZA.name: South Africa
ZA.carryOverNotes: Statutory leave must be taken within 6 months after the leave cycle or it is forfeited. Contractual leave capped at 25 days.
ZA.terminationNotes: Mandatory payout of unused statutory leave. Annual leave cannot run concurrently with notice period.

NG.name: Nigeria
NG.carryOverNotes: Carry-over permitted by mutual agreement up to 12 months following the year earned.
NG.terminationNotes: Mandatory payout of earned, unused statutory/contractual annual leave.

CI.name: Ivory Coast
CI.carryOverNotes: Postponement permitted for up to 2 consecutive years by agreement or operational necessity.
CI.terminationNotes: Mandatory payout for all unused accrued annual leave upon termination.

ET.name: Ethiopia
ET.carryOverNotes: Postponement permitted for up to 2 consecutive years maximum.
ET.terminationNotes: Mandatory payout of earned, unused statutory leave within valid limits.

AU.name: Australia
AU.carryOverNotes: Annual leave never expires statutorily and carries over indefinitely.
AU.terminationNotes: Mandatory 100% payout of all unused accrued annual leave.

AT.name: Austria
AT.carryOverNotes: Leave carries forward and expires 2 years after the end of the leave year in which it accrued.
AT.terminationNotes: Mandatory payout (Ersatzleistung) of unused pro-rata leave upon termination.
